translations.text: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hilkiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth, says the Lord.

I will sweep away human beings and animals. I will sweep away the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea. I will bring a stumbling block upon sinners, and I will destroy humanity from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
I will raise my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will destroy from this place what remains of Baal, and the name of the pagan priests along with the priests,
and all who worship the heavenly armies on the rooftops, and all who worship and swear by the Lord while also swearing by Milcom,
and all who turn away from the Lord, and all who neither seek the Lord nor inquire about him.
Fear before the Lord of lords, for the day of the Lord is near. The Lord has prepared sacrifices and invited his guests.
On the day of the Lord's sacrifice, I will punish the officials, the sons of kings, and all who wear foreign clothing.
On that day I will punish all the robbers and plunderers who fill their judges' houses with plunder and deceit.
On that day, says the Lord, there will be a cry from the Fishermen's Gate, wailing from the other gate, and a great crash from the heights.
Wail, inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan have been broken, and all who carry silver have perished.
At that time, says the Lord, I will search Jerusalem with a lamp and punish the men who despise their guardian and say in their hearts, 'The Lord does neither good nor harm.'
Their possessions will become plunder, and their houses will be destroyed. They will build houses but will not live in them; they will plant vineyards but will not drink their wine.
The great day of the Lord is near. It is very near and coming quickly. The sound of the day of the Lord is bitter, harsh, and mighty.
That day is a day of wrath. It is a day of distress and anguish, a day of turmoil and destruction, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness.
It is a day of the horn and the battle cry against fortified cities and high towers.
I will bring distress upon human beings so that they walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the Lord. Their blood will be poured out like dust, and their flesh like dung.

Their gold and silver will not be able to rescue them on the day of the Lord's wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of his jealousy, for the Lord will bring turmoil and an end upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
Gather together and bind yourselves together, you people who will not accept discipline,
before you become like chaff that passes away, before the fierce anger of the Lord comes upon you, and before the day of the Lord's wrath comes upon you.
Seek the Lord, all you humble people of the earth. Practice justice, and seek righteousness and humility. Perhaps you will be hidden on the day of the Lord's wrath.
For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon will be destroyed. Ashdod's people will be driven away at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.
Woe to those who inhabit the seacoast and to the people of the Cretans! The word of the Lord is against you, Canaan and land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until no inhabitant remains.
The seacoast will become sheepfolds, and the Cretans' land a pasture for flocks of sheep.

The seacoast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah. They will graze there, and in the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon, for the Lord their God will care for them and bring back their captives.
I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the Ammonites, who insulted my people and acted arrogantly against their territory.

Therefore, as I live, says the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, Moab will become like Sodom, and the Ammonites like Gomorrah. Their vegetation will be destroyed, their [?] will perish, and they will be a ruin forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and those who remain of my people will inherit them.
This will be their reward for their pride, because they insulted and exalted themselves against the people of the Lord Almighty, against Israel.
The Lord will reveal himself against them to destroy all the kings of the earth. All the islands of the seas will worship him, each person from his own place.
You Cushites too will be slain by the sword.
He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, and he will make Nineveh a ruin and a wasteland like the desert.

Flocks will lie down within her, along with all the wild animals of the nations. Pelicans and hedgehogs will spend the night in her houses. Wild animals will roar within her, and devastation will be at her gates, because her foundation has been exposed.

This is the mighty city that lived undisturbed, saying in her heart, “I am, and there is no other like me.” How she has become a ruin, a resting place for wild animals! Everyone who passes by her will be astonished, whistle, wave his hand, and say:
“Woe to the renowned and redeemed city, the city of Jonah!”
She did not obey the voice or accept correction. She did not trust in the Lord or draw near to her God.
Her leaders within her roar like lions, and her judges are like evening wolves that leave nothing until morning.
Her prophets are reckless and are wicked men. Her priests have defiled the sanctuary and violated the law.
The righteous Lord is in her midst and does no injustice. Morning after morning he brings his judgments to light and does not delay, but the unjust person knows no shame.
I destroyed nations, and [?] was devastated. I laid waste their streets so that no one passes through. Their cities are deserted, without anyone, without an inhabitant.

I said, “You will fear me and accept correction from me, and everything I commanded concerning her will not disappear from her sight.” But they prepared themselves, drew near, and corrupted all their deeds.

Therefore wait for me, says the Lord, for the day when I rise to testify. For my judgment has arrived: to gather nations and bring kingdoms together, to pour out my wrath upon them, all my fierce anger. For the whole earth will be consumed by the fire of my jealousy.
Then I will give the peoples a choice language, so that they may all call on the name of the Lord and serve him under one yoke.
From beyond the rivers of Cush they will bring me sacrifices.

On that day you will not be ashamed of all your deeds by which you acted unjustly against me. Then I will remove from you the strength of your pride, and you will no longer act arrogantly on my holy mountain.
I will leave within you a poor and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the Lord.
Those who remain of the house of Israel will do no wrong and speak no lies. No deceitful tongue will be found in their mouths, for they will graze and lie down, with no one to frighten them.
Sing praise, daughter Zion! Shout for joy, Israel! Rejoice and exult with all your heart, daughter Jerusalem!
The Lord has removed the judgments against you and driven your enemies away from you. The King of Israel, the Lord, is within you; you will never again see disaster.
On that day it will be said to Jerusalem, “Do not be afraid,” and to Zion, “Do not let your hands grow weak.”
The Lord your God is within you, a mighty warrior and savior. He will delight you with joy, renew you in his love, and make you rejoice with praise,
as on a festival day. I will remove from you those who spoke insults against you.

Look, at that time I will deal with all those who bring humiliation within you. I will save the oppressed and gather those who are far away. I will give them renown and praise throughout the land where they suffered shame.

At that time I will bring you back, and at that time I will gather you. I will give you renown and praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your captives before their eyes, says the Lord.
